name: on_resume_wrapped

provenance.source: Exact .139 pagemanager decompilation; page lifecycle ladder recovered from the state byte at page+40 and the handler-chain callbacks.

notes: Brings a page fully up: calls on_create_wrapped (0x0c696ae8, rebuilding the root view and every widget through the page on_create callback at page[19]), then on_start_wrapped (0x0c693996), then the resume leg. Climbs from states 4/5/8/9/18 to 17, so it is also the recovery path after a forced teardown. UI owner thread only, never under the interrupt lock. Device probe pending.
